# Methods Library Index

**`methods/ideation/` is the ideation shotgun's method pool.** A card there is selectable; a card anywhere else is not, and its own `excluded_because:` says why.

The failure mode that makes the boundary a folder rather than a convention: an agent handed a card it cannot run does not report that it cannot run it. It produces a fluent, well-formed, entirely invented result, indistinguishable from evidence at synthesis time.

## Validation Methods

Not in the shotgun pool: these answer downstream validation questions rather than interpreting the shared belief/hunch pair.

| Method | Category | Why it is not a shotgun lens | File |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crowded Market Thesis Test | adjacency | needs a named market and a named entrant to test crowdedness against | [crowded-market-thesis-test.md](validation/crowded-market-thesis-test.md) |
| Failure Inversion (Thesis Pre-Mortem) | inversion | pre-mortems a thesis; needs the thesis | [failure-inversion.md](validation/failure-inversion.md) |
| Four-Lens Idea Pressure Test | evaluation | pressure-tests an idea that already exists — evaluation, not exploration | [four-lens-idea-pressure-test.md](validation/four-lens-idea-pressure-test.md) |
| Hair-on-Fire Problem Classification | first-principles | classifies an identified pain as a downstream validation judgment, not a multi-method interpretation | [hair-on-fire-classification.md](validation/hair-on-fire-classification.md) |
| Idea Quality Score | first-principles | scores a formed idea across dimensions; scoring a field is meaningless | [idea-quality-score.md](validation/idea-quality-score.md) |
| Kill Criteria Contract | inversion | written before an experiment, about that experiment | [kill-criteria-contract.md](validation/kill-criteria-contract.md) |
| Nurture Coefficient | market-signal | computed over 20–30 completed outreach touchpoints | [nurture-coefficient.md](validation/nurture-coefficient.md) |
| Pain Point Scorecard | first-principles | ranks a slate of mined candidates — runs *after* a shotgun, on its output | [pain-point-scorecard.md](validation/pain-point-scorecard.md) |
| Path-Out Test | market | asks whether a specific niche expands; presupposes the niche | [path-out-test.md](validation/path-out-test.md) |
| Search Trend Validation | market-signal | demand proxy for a specific term set; sharper once a hunch names the terms | [search-trend-validation.md](validation/search-trend-validation.md) |
| Stated Want vs. Latent Need | customer-validation | reads what customers said in interviews — no interviews exist yet | [stated-want-vs-latent-need.md](validation/stated-want-vs-latent-need.md) |
| The Well Test | customer-validation | tests demand *shape* for a named idea after its core problem has been interpreted | [the-well-test.md](validation/the-well-test.md) |
| "Would You Have a Use for This?" (Use-Case Multiplication) | customer-validation | a question you ask a person, about a described solution | [would-you-have-a-use-for-this.md](validation/would-you-have-a-use-for-this.md) |

## Mutation Methods

Not in the shotgun pool: each needs interview evidence that changed the picture. The shotgun's reframe mode consumes their conclusions through the evidence delta.

| Method | Category | Why it is not a shotgun lens | File |
|---|---|---|---|
| Organizing Principle Anchor | jtbd | keeps a *pivot* from scattering; presupposes a pivot | [organizing-principle-anchor.md](mutation/organizing-principle-anchor.md) |
| Reverse Storytelling ("Write the Book Backwards") | wedge-narrowing | works backwards from an endgame; needs a hunch to have an endgame | [reverse-storytelling.md](mutation/reverse-storytelling.md) |
| Stack Climbing | adjacency | asks where value sits once a wedge is validated | [stack-climbing.md](mutation/stack-climbing.md) |
| Timing Reframe | timing | needs evidence that a pain is real but mistimed | [timing-reframe.md](mutation/timing-reframe.md) |
| Wedge Narrowing | wedge-narrowing | narrows an entry surface after adoption evidence came back scattered | [wedge-narrowing.md](mutation/wedge-narrowing.md) |
